scope: Haiti medical discovery — Université Notre Dame d'Haïti Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: The faculty's official 2024/25 enrolment notice states that applicants may enrol in medicine or pharmacy and requires the payment slip among the enrolment documents.
The faculty's online admission form is specifically for first-year pharmacy and lists a non-refundable 5,000 Haitian gourde fee; it is not evidence of the medicine programme fee.

holdReasons: No current medicine-specific admission notice, fee schedule or mandatory-charge schedule was located; the pharmacy form must not be represented as a medicine fee.
No authoritative current evidence establishes programme duration, teaching language, full academic or international eligibility, intake, curriculum, clinical sites or professional recognition.
Accommodation, scholarship or loan options, safety arrangements and student support could not be verified from authoritative current sources.
nextAction: Obtain the current medicine admissions notice and fee card, then verify teaching language, curriculum, named clinical-training sites, recognition and support before considering a payload.
